findings.title: Ghost CMS CVE-2026-26980 Active Mass Exploitation Confirmed — 700+ Sites Compromised in ClickFix Campaign (Harvard / Oxford / DuckDuckGo Among Victims)
findings.affected_technology: Ghost CMS Content API (versions prior to 6.19.1, patched 2026-02); unpatched-instance long tail still widely exposed in 2026-05
findings.summary: QiAnXin XLab (with Anthropic Claude as research assistant) disclosed 2026-05-25 active mass exploitation of CVE-2026-26980 across 700+ Ghost CMS sites — including Harvard, Oxford, and DuckDuckGo — using the SQL injection to harvest Admin API Keys and inject ClickFix-campaign JavaScript via Ghost's content APIs.

findings.title: Joomla! com_users Triple Critical Privilege-Escalation Batch — CVE-2026-48898 / 48899 / 48904 (CVSS 9.8 Each, Unauthenticated)
findings.affected_technology: Joomla! CMS 4.0.0 through 5.4.5 (current stable LTS line) and 6.0.0 through 6.1.0 (pre-release); com_users component — batch task endpoint + group editing webservice
findings.summary: Three coordinated CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated privilege-escalation CVEs in Joomla!'s com_users component published to NVD 2026-05-26 — two on the batch task endpoint and one on the group editing webservice endpoint — affecting Joomla 4.x / 5.x / 6.x with no public PoC yet but widely scanned given the Drupalgeddon-class trajectory pattern.

findings.title: Digital Knowledge KnowledgeDeliver Zero-Day RCE — CVE-2026-5426 ASP.NET ViewState Deserialization via Hardcoded machineKey, Godzilla Web Shell + Cobalt Strike Beacon Deployment
findings.affected_technology: Digital Knowledge KnowledgeDeliver (Japanese-market Learning Management System, ASP.NET) — deployments prior to 2026-02-24 vendor patch
findings.summary: Mandiant + Google Threat Intelligence Group jointly disclosed 2026-05-25 active zero-day exploitation of KnowledgeDeliver — hardcoded ASP.NET machineKey values in web.config enable unauthenticated ViewState forgery → LosFormatter.Deserialize() RCE; observed payloads include Godzilla web shell + Cobalt Strike Beacon against predominantly Japanese deployments.

findings.title: Microsoft SharePoint Server CVE-2026-45659 Post-Auth Deserialization RCE (CVSS 8.8) — Late-Surfacing From May 2026 Patch Tuesday
findings.affected_technology: Microsoft Office SharePoint Server (on-prem versions per MSRC affected-products table); CWE-502 deserialization of untrusted data, network-reachable, authenticated low-privilege attacker
findings.summary: NVD-published 2026-05-22 (modified 2026-05-26) authenticated SharePoint Server RCE via deserialization of untrusted data with CVSS 8.8 — not featured in mainstream Patch Tuesday relayer summaries, surfaces via THN late-attention coverage 2026-05-25 / 2026-05-26 (continues the MEMORY 2026-05-14 Patch Tuesday CVE-list relayer divergence pattern).

findings.title: FUXA Industrial SCADA Multi-CVE Pre-Auth RCE Batch — CVE-2026-43945 / 43946 / 43947 Plus 3 Companion Critical GHSA Advisories
findings.affected_technology: FUXA open-source web-based SCADA / HMI / IIoT platform (github.com/frangoteam/FUXA); 10 advisories Feb-May 2026 spanning multiple pre-auth RCE primitives (script-test-mode authz bypass, path manipulation + config injection, arbitrary upload-API file write, tag-write, scheduler-write, hardcoded JWT signing secret)
findings.summary: GitHub Security Advisory database surfaced 2026-05-26 a coordinated FUXA SCADA / HMI multi-CVE batch including pre-auth RCE via Script Test Mode authorization bypass (43947), pre-auth RCE via path manipulation + configuration injection (43945), arbitrary tag-value disclosure (43946), and three companion critical GHSA advisories spanning upload-API arbitrary file write + arbitrary device-tag and scheduler write — extending the self-hosted-default-no-auth pattern into industrial-OT scope.
